pagination.contract: Automatic walks require one response array plus an exact next_cursor or count/offset request contract; multi-array sync/report envelopes remain explicit.

auth.selected: client_id, secret and the per-Item access_token come only from the encrypted connection, injected into the JSON request body of the operations that name them; Plaid-Version is a binding-owned static header.

compatibility_sensitive_posture.containment: Established operations retain their approval contracts, but top-level inputs are closed, raw-body credential substitution is blocked, required empty JSON bodies are explicit, and unsafe response integers are preserved. Every new mutation is approval-always, and every new read is uncached.
compatibility_sensitive_posture.follow_up: A future response projection or secret-redaction contract can narrow established token-bearing responses without silently breaking their catalog API.

source_decision.reason: Plaid records are financial, identity, compliance, and control-plane objects rather than user-authored task, note, or project work. Issues are Plaid integration incidents, not user work items, so no work_entity_sources are declared.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The previous Plaid pack exposed 27 catalog operations over 25 official routes and carried no immutable OpenAPI pin.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Preserve all established catalog contracts, add 8 bounded feature packs, and cover 301 of 331 official routes from one immutable source.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Plaid request schemas repeat client_id and secret as body fields even though the enrolled connection already owns those credentials.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Omit credential fields, recursively close every generated request schema, add closed schemas to compatibility operations, and declare empty static bodies so caller body_raw cannot substitute credentials.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Required JSON bodies whose only required schema fields are connection credentials previously degraded to a bodyless POST when no optional argument was supplied.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Teach explicit static_body:{} bindings to emit literal {} only when no dynamic body field exists, with focused gateway regression coverage.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Treating Plaid-Version as an enrolled secret lets account defaults or user input drift away from the pinned response and request schemas.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Remove Plaid-Version from the credential enrollment shape and set a binding-owned 2020-09-14 header on every generated operation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The public OpenAPI contains deprecated routes and x-hidden-from-docs intent-only routes, including an inbound FDX notification receiver.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Exclude all 30 deprecated or hidden operations with an exact census instead of presenting them as public outbound capabilities.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Auth, processor, identity, credit, and transfer responses can contain bank numbers, long-lived tokens, PII, reports, and other capability material.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Require approval for every new mutation, disable read caching, scan request and response graphs, publish no workflows, and retain all data on the user server.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Plaid Transfer, Payment Initiation, bank-transfer, wallet, refund, and ledger calls can authorize or move money despite using POST like ordinary reads.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Classify exact money-moving operations as destructive and approval-always; require documented idempotency_key fields and true is_idempotent flags where available.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Plaid list operations mix cursor, offset, multi-array sync, and report envelopes; a generic paginator would silently discard arrays such as modified or removed.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Automate only single-array cursor or count/offset contracts and leave multi-array or ambiguous pagination controls explicit.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Eight current report and statement routes return PDF bytes from POST, but response_capture is deliberately limited to read-tier GET.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Exclude all eight routes with an exact census rather than corrupting bytes through JSON parsing or silently widening the shared capture contract.

audit_findings_folded.finding: JavaScript JSON parsing can round undocumented future integer expansions even though the current Plaid schema declares no int64 request fields.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Enable unsafe-integer string preservation on every JSON response, including all compatibility operations.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Beta routes share the stable version header but Plaid does not give beta products normal breaking-change guarantees.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Label every /beta operation in its catalog description and audit fixture while retaining its risk-tier approval behavior.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The 27 established operations include sensitive reads and token-bearing responses under never or ask approval contracts.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Preserve installed compatibility while closing input authority, blocking raw credential substitution, disabling unsafe integer coercion, enumerating inherited routes, and adding no workflow over them.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Plaid financial and compliance objects do not satisfy the authoring guide task, note, or project Source rule.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Retain the eight proven entity projections for catalog use and declare no work_entity_sources.
